description: §6.13.5 (S479) static check of a LITERAL held write: on a `debounced=` engine, `@doc = .Archived` names a variant that no state reachable from `.Draft` (Draft, Review, Published) is or admits — its only incoming edge is from `.Purged`, which is itself unreachable. Every commit of it would be refused, so it is E-ENGINE-INVALID-TRANSITION at the write site. XFAIL on impl#1: it parses neither the §66 `single` engine opener nor a timed engine (S471 policy: impl#1 is frozen; carried gap g-impl1-timed-engine-commit-s479).
rationale: §6.13.5: "Static check of LITERAL held writes: a write `@var = .Variant` to a timed engine cell, where no variant reachable from the cell's initial variant along its `rule=` edges is `.Variant` or has `.Variant` in its `rule=`, could never commit and SHALL be `E-ENGINE-INVALID-TRANSITION` (§34) at the write site." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 8 ("Mitigate with a static check of literal held writes").
